title: GET_STREAM_INFO is not notified when START/STOP_STREAMING changes a Stream Input's started state
body:
Found by the in-house qualification run of 2026-10-19 on the AX7101 (dev e9cbb676, processor 2cbed0a9).

**Behaviour.** A controller sends START_STREAMING or STOP_STREAMING to a Stream Input. The input's started/stopped state changes, but no GET_STREAM_INFO unsolicited notification goes to the other registered controllers.

**Required.**
- Milan v1.2 5.4.5.2 (last paragraph) and Table 5.22: GET_STREAM_INFO is notified when the "Started/stopped state (Stream Input only)" changes. "Asynchronously of any command" says when it is sent, not which changes count.
- 5.4.2.19 and 5.4.2.20: START/STOP_STREAMING change exactly that state.
- The notification is not a response to the command, so it goes to every registered controller (5.4.5.1).

**Source.** `hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:3563-3565`.

**Done when:**
- every started/stopped change of a Stream Input, by command or otherwise, queues one GET_STREAM_INFO notification to every registered controller;
- the requester is not excluded, because this is not the command's own response;
- a suite case and a planted mutant cover it;
- the processor's suites and the parent's consumer gates pass.
